meta.name: verify-ui-change
meta.description: Check that a change to a web app actually works in the running app before calling it done. Drives the real page and returns a pass/fail verdict with the request that fired, the state that moved, and the file:line to fix. Use after editing a component, a form, a route, or an API call; when you have said "fixed" but have not opened the app; when the user asks "does it actually work?"; or when a change looks right on screen and you cannot prove it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改完网页代码后，自动打开运行中的应用跑一遍，告诉你是通过还是失败、哪一行要改。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果改完网页代码却还没打开应用确认它是否真的生效。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edited web code and haven't proven it actually works yet.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会驱动你正在运行的真实页面来验证改动:先写下预期后果再操作,最后给出通过/失败/未知的判定,并附上触发的请求、变化的状态和要改的 file:line。
howto.when: 在改完组件、表单、路由等之后,或你说了「修好了」却没打开应用、用户问「真的能用吗」时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证这个改动在跑着的应用里真的生效了
say.note: 会驱动真实页面并给出判定

say.text: 我改了登录表单,确认提交后 /api/login 返回 200
say.note: 先写预期后果,再断言结果

say.text: 这改动看着没问题,你能证明它真能用吗?
say.note: 无法证明时返回 unknown,不算通过

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives your running page to verify a change: it names the expected outcome before acting, then returns a pass/fail/unknown verdict with the request that fired, the state that moved, and the file:line to fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you edit a component, form, route, or API call; when you have said "fixed" without opening the app; or when the user asks "does it actually work?"

say_en.text: Verify this change actually works in the running app
say_en.note: Drives the real page and returns a verdict

say_en.text: I changed the login form — confirm POST /api/login returns 200
say_en.note: Names the outcome first, then asserts it

say_en.text: This change looks fine on screen; can you prove it works?
say_en.note: Unprovable results come back unknown, not a pass
